title: Singapore Couples Special with Jewel Changi
alt: The Rain Vortex waterfall inside Jewel Changi Airport in Singapore
transport: Private airport transfers with shared coaches for tours and tickets

expert.name: Nisha Rao
expert.quote: This is the fullest Singapore we sell. Thirteen experiences in four nights, and still a river cruise and a coastal walk in there.
expert.tip: Do the Chinatown Heritage Centre before the Night Safari on day one. It is indoors, it is air conditioned and it fills the slow afternoon after a morning flight.

summary: Five busy days for two. Chinatown heritage and the Night Safari on arrival, a Sentosa day with SkyHelix and HydroDash, the ArtScience Museum with a river cruise, the SkyPark with a coastal walk and Harry Potter, then Jewel Changi on the way out.
included: Included: 4 nights at the V Hotel Lavender with daily breakfast; Chinatown Heritage Centre; Night Safari with tram ride; two way cable car sky pass; SkyHelix Sentosa; HydroDash; Wings of Time; ArtScience Museum Future World; half day city tour; Singapore River Cruise; Marina Bay Sands SkyPark; guided coastal walk at Labrador Park; Harry Potter Visions of Magic; Jewel Changi attractions; 15 private and shared transfers.
not_included: Not included: international flights; visa charges; travel insurance; lunches and dinners; attractions not named above; personal expenses.

day_titles.1: Arrival, Chinatown and the Night Safari
day_titles.4: SkyPark, Labrador Park and Harry Potter

1: Arrival at Changi Airport and private sedan transfer to the V Hotel Lavender
Shared transfer to the Chinatown Heritage Centre and its restored shophouse rooms
Evening shared transfer to Mandai for the Night Safari with a tram ride
Supper near Lavender MRT when you get back
2: Breakfast, then shared transfer to Mount Faber for the cable car
Two way sky pass across to Sentosa with the harbour below
SkyHelix for an open air seat 79 metres up, then HydroDash on the water
Wings of Time on Siloso beach to close the day
3: Breakfast, then shared transfer to the ArtScience Museum
Future World with its light rooms and the digital waterfall
Half day city tour through Merlion Park, Chinatown and the civic district
Singapore River Cruise from Clarke Quay as the lights come on
4: Breakfast, then shared transfer to Marina Bay Sands
SkyPark on level 57 for the view over the bay and the Gardens
Guided coastal walk at Labrador Nature Park along the old sea wall
Harry Potter Visions of Magic in the afternoon, an indoor walkthrough
5: Private sedan transfer to Changi Airport with time to spare
Changi Experience Studio and the Canopy Park bridges at Jewel
Last look at the Rain Vortex before your flight home

stops.name: Singapore
stops.accom: 4 nights · Breakfast included · Standard room · 4★ · V Hotel Lavender, directly above Lavender MRT with a 24 hour food court below

program.name: Heritage, heights and the airport garden
program.description: Four nights above an MRT station, with a heritage museum, two island viewpoints, a river cruise and the Jewel canopy on the last morning.

activities.name: Chinatown Heritage Centre
activities.description: Three restored shophouses on Pagoda Street, furnished as the cubicle homes of early Chinese migrants to Singapore.

activities.name: Night Safari with Tram Ride
activities.description: A tram circuit through the Mandai park after dark, past the elephants, hyenas and leopards.

activities.name: Singapore Cable Car Sky Pass
activities.description: A two way ride between Mount Faber, HarbourFront and Sentosa, high above the working harbour.

activities.name: SkyHelix Sentosa
activities.description: An open air gondola that rises 79 metres above Sentosa and turns slowly for a full view of the southern islands.

activities.name: HydroDash
activities.description: A floating obstacle course off Palawan beach with climbing walls, slides and trampolines on the water.

activities.name: Wings of Time
activities.description: A night show on Siloso beach built from water screens, lasers, flame jets and a short film.

activities.name: ArtScience Museum Future World
activities.description: The permanent teamLab exhibition at Marina Bay Sands, with light installations and a digital waterfall room.

activities.name: Half Day Singapore City Tour
activities.description: A shared coach tour of Merlion Park, Marina Bay, Chinatown and the colonial civic district.

activities.name: Singapore River Cruise
activities.description: A bumboat from Clarke Quay past the godowns and bridges of the old trading river, about forty minutes.

activities.name: Marina Bay Sands SkyPark
activities.description: The level 57 observation deck looking down on the bay, the Gardens and the financial district.

activities.name: Guided Coastal Walk at Labrador Park
activities.description: A guided walk at Labrador Nature Park along the old sea wall and gun batteries, with the Strait on one side.

activities.name: Harry Potter Visions of Magic
activities.description: An indoor walkthrough of nine art installations drawn from the films, at Resorts World Sentosa.

activities.name: Jewel Changi Attractions
activities.description: The Changi Experience Studio and Canopy Park bridges beside the Rain Vortex, inside the airport itself.
